pages.text: A sinister statue that can save the lives of illagers and similar ilk that are bound to it.

Rather than dying, those bound to the idol will teleport back to it at the precipice of death, unless it was by their master dismissing them with a Wand/Staff, or if the idol they're bound with is in another dimension. They will, however, be grievously wounded, unable to be revived for a Minecraft day, and be crippled for 5 minutes until they are sufficiently healed.

To bind your servant to the idol, simply use a Waystone, have it bound to the statue, and right click your servant with it. The idol can only hold up to 16 servants (by default) and will not accept more after. Much like other artifices, the idol requires Soul Energy to function, which it gets by placing it on top of a filled $(l:intro/cursed_cage)Cursed Cage$().
